discussion.body: Implemented nested spaces. Zoom through 1024× home spawns a child at camera focus (or re-enters a nearby portal). Zoom out through 1/1024× exits to parent, or inserts a parent if this is root. Portal marks are saved on the parent. Checkerboard and origin follow flags. Product-to-root is display-only in the dev panel. How to verify: zoom in until nest increments, draw in the child, zoom out, confirm parent objects did not move, double-click the portal to return. Filed BUG-003 for undo/camera. Waiting on your check; not complete until you mark the set.
